builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-13: Hudl's public rosters for every school's girls volleyball teams, NCSA's women's volleyball school pages and a SportsRecruits profile-address probe, over the 322 JV players MaxPreps lists; each Hudl and NCSA page re-read by an independent refuter.
notes: The JV players' own recruiting pages, linked by the rule of data/volleyball/rosters-enrichment.json's profiles[]. Joined on team slug + the name the team page's JV list gives. No claimed-MaxPreps pages (the JV career pages were not read). A player on both the JV list and the varsity roster has her pages in the varsity file. Recall is partial.
